# rvertnet

`rvertnet` is a client for interacting with
[VertNet.org](http://vertnet.org/).

VertNet.org API docs:
<https://github.com/VertNet/webapp/wiki/The-API-search-function>

## Installation

Stable CRAN version

``` r

install.packages("rvertnet")
```

Development version from GitHub

``` r

remotes::install_github("ropensci/rvertnet", build_vignettes = TRUE)
```

## [Get started](https://docs.ropensci.org/rvertnet/articles/rvertnet.html)

[View vignette on ropensci
website](https://docs.ropensci.org/rvertnet/articles/rvertnet.html)

Or, view vignette locally in your web browser

``` r

browseVignettes("rvertnet")
```

Or, view vignette in the Rstudio help pane

``` r

vignette("rvertnet")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`bigsearch()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rvertnet/reference/bigsearch.md)
  : Request to download a large number of VertNet records.
- [`rvertnet-defunct`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rvertnet/reference/rvertnet-defunct.md)
  : Defunct functions in rvertnet
- [`rvertnet-package`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rvertnet/reference/rvertnet-package.md)
  [`rvertnet`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rvertnet/reference/rvertnet-package.md)
  : Search VertNet archives using R
- [`searchbyterm()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rvertnet/reference/searchbyterm.md)
  : Search by term
- [`simple_dwc_terms`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rvertnet/reference/simple_dwc_terms.md)
  : Darwin core terms
- [`spatialsearch()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rvertnet/reference/spatialsearch.md)
  : Find records within some distance of a point given latitude and
  longitude.
- [`traitsearch()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rvertnet/reference/traitsearch.md)
  : Trait focused search
- [`vert_id()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rvertnet/reference/vert_id.md)
  : Search by Vertnet occurrence ID
- [`vertmap()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rvertnet/reference/vertmap.md)
  : Make a simple map to visualize VertNet data.
- [`vertsearch()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rvertnet/reference/vertsearch.md)
  : Find records using a global full-text search of VertNet archives.
- [`vertsummary()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rvertnet/reference/vertsummary.md)
  : Summarize a set of records downloaded from VertNet.
